author: /root/histo_depth
method: Read all 100 initial and all 97 retained final question stems, options, keys, right/wrong rationales, source locators, scope tags, and difficulties; read all 12 final concept summaries, key points, traps, source mappings, and objective references; independently checked the cited Junqueira passages, cardiovascular/immune/respiratory lecture extracts, and all six source crops. Compared final stems with 1,166 existing histology and relevant Term 2 bank stems. This is an independent agent source-and-assessment review, not faculty or clinical-expert validation.
summary: Approved after all content, difficulty, originality, and answer-position findings were resolved. The final 97-question payload has defensible single best answers, synchronized distractor rationales, explicit course-versus-book scope, exact concept and verification mappings, no retained substantial restem, and balanced answer positions. The central staging validator reports zero histology errors.

sourceChecks.source: Junqueira's Basic Histology: Text and Atlas, 16th ed.
sourceChecks.result: Mapped heart-wall, vascular, lymphoid, and respiratory claims rechecked against extracted local-PDF text; source-sensitive claims below were checked at their cited pages.
Course-scope vascular-wall, vessel-class, lymphatic, endocardial, and conducting-tissue mappings checked against the timestamped transcript.

sourceChecks.source: Immune System and Lymphatic Organs with narration slides and transcript
sourceChecks.result: Thymic epithelial-reticular types, selection, lymph-node, MALT, and splenic mappings checked; ASR slips were not propagated.

sourceChecks.source: Respiratory ENG original lecture and transcript
sourceChecks.result: Course-scope upper-airway, bronchial-tree, and alveolar-unit mappings checked against the timestamped material.
All crops visually inspected at original resolution; targets are legible and source captions or explicit answer text are excluded.

resolvedFindings.finding: The prosthetic-valve stem initially risked overgeneralizing anticoagulation as a universal clinical rule.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The final stem is explicitly limited to a mechanical prosthesis lacking complete biologic surface coverage and asks for the missing histologic property. Junqueira printed p. 218 / PDF p. 229 directly links incomplete endothelial covering to thrombosis and exogenous anticoagulants.

resolvedFindings.finding: An earlier scar-based framing incorrectly implied that scar creates an accessory muscular bridge.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The final stem uses a congenital accessory myocardial pathway and tests only the cardiac skeleton’s normal atrioventricular electrical insulation, matching Junqueira printed p. 217 / PDF p. 228.

resolvedFindings.finding: The first version mentioned only overdistension after reticular-fiber weakening.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The correct option and explanation now include both increased collapse and excessive-distension risk while elastic recoil is relatively preserved, matching Junqueira printed p. 362 / PDF p. 373.

resolvedFindings.finding: Clinical wrappers and direct source cues inflated difficulty metadata.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The listed one-step or modest-inference items were reduced to difficulty 3 or 4. Only three genuinely paired/multistep items remain difficulty 5; the final distribution is D2=4, D3=24, D4=66, D5=3.

resolvedFindings.finding: The three initial items substantially restemmed existing large-vein, alveolar-duct-knob, and bronchial/pulmonary-anastomosis questions.
resolvedFindings.resolution: All three were removed from questions, concept objectives, coverage, and verification. The final retained set has no exact current-stem match and no remaining substantial restem found in the targeted similarity review.

resolvedFindings.finding: The initial answer-key positions were highly predictable (A=81, B=15, C=1, D=0).
resolvedFindings.resolution: Options were deterministically permuted with correct answer text and rationale associations preserved. Final positions are A=25, B=24, C=24, D=24.

resolvedFindings.finding: Concept-level contradictions, false course scope, stale objective references, and image answer leakage were explicitly checked.
resolvedFindings.resolution: All 12 concept summaries align with the reviewed questions and cited sources; all 57 course-scope items have specific lecture/slide metadata, all 40 remaining items are book-extension, objectives and verification map exactly to the 97 retained IDs, and the six crops are legible without source captions.

checks: Every retained question has four option IDs, one keyed answer, a correct-answer explanation, and distractor explanations keyed to exactly the three non-answer IDs.
Final concept objective references equal the retained question-ID set with no duplicate references; verification.json contains exactly the same 97 IDs.
Course-scope and book-extension tags are mutually explicit, and every course-scope item carries lecture or slide locator metadata.
No past-question, official-exam, or faculty-validation provenance is claimed.
